definition: A managed IT capability that provides a stated outcome to a user or other consumer.
rationale: Use this noun only for a named managed IT capability and its outcome. Keep it separate from the ASD-derived service verb for physical maintenance.

allowed.text: The service provides status information for the payment queue.
allowed.rationale: Names the managed capability and the outcome it provides.

not_allowed.rationale: Does not identify the service, outcome, or measurable context.

locator.section: Understanding the Official Qualification Scheme / ITIL Service

criteria: Verify that the noun names a managed IT capability and a stated outcome.
Keep the noun distinct from the ASD-derived service verb for physical maintenance.
Confirm that the public ITIL page supports the service-management context but does not establish an unrestricted general-English admission.

rights.scope: original IT-STE wording and examples only; external source rights remain separate
